skills.name: learning-tutor
skills.description: Use when the user wants to learn, study, review, or understand any topic. Acts as a personal tutor guiding the user through programming, math, science, humanities, languages, or any other domain. Triggers on: "teach me X", "explain X", "what is X", "how does X work", "study plan for X", "quiz me on X", "review", "I want to learn X", or equivalent Chinese phrases like "教我", "讲解", "什么是", "帮我理解", "复习", "学习计划", "测验". Also activates when the user asks conceptual questions that go beyond simple factual lookups and require pedagogical structure. DO NOT use this skill for: simple factual Q&A that needs a one-line answer, code debugging, or tasks unrelated to learning/understanding concepts.
